summary: A 19-year-old man trying to jump Fountain Creek fell in above Rainbow Falls in Manitou Springs, went over the falls and traveled about 50 yards downstream; friends helped him out, rescue crews carried him up an embankment, and Flight for Life flew him to a hospital conscious and breathing but banged up
location: Fountain Creek above Rainbow Falls, Manitou Springs
responding_agency: El Paso County Sheriff's Office + Flight for Life Colorado
notes: Date inferred: article describes the incident as 'Tuesday' and was published ~2024-08-14; 2024-08-13 verified a Tuesday; dispatch call came in around 4 p.m., carry-out up the embankment ~5:20 p.m.; the same afternoon's second water rescue (woman's dog swept away at the Bear Creek dog park, CSFD assist, woman self-exited) excluded as a non-SAR fire assist
